asset: Street kit for the BeltLine Eastside block (M1-08, #40): tree_round, tree_tall, bench, lamp, bike_rack, bin, planter, roof_unit, water_tower, each at LOD0 (detailed) and LOD1 (<name>_lod1)
tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP (execute_blender_code), glTF 2.0 exporter
source: scripts/blender/street_kit.py. Every prop is built from Blender primitives (cube, cylinder, cone, icosphere, UV sphere) and swept tubes by the script. No library, scan, or generated model is in it.
prompt: None. The script is the full recipe; run it again to rebuild the file.
credits: Original work for this project. No third-party art. No paid generation credits.
format: GLB, one mesh per prop and level of detail, vertex colors (COLOR_0), smooth and flat normals, no textures, no Draco
murals: The 16 mural designs are drawn at run time by src/render/murals.js from a fixed seed: original shapes and lettering, no third-party art.
